subject: Loop default-on in auto mode: enforce autostart, not just nudge
description:
Make the orchestrator heartbeat loop DEFAULT-ON in auto mode (bypass-permissions / auto-accept) instead of the current soft nudge that only asks the model to call loop_control.

THE GAP (from code map): no auto-mode signal exists today. The /loop/start path, active-loop check, and classify composer all already exist and /loop/start is idempotent.

Implement:
1. AUTO-MODE SIGNAL: detect permission mode from the UserPromptSubmit hook payload. Claude Code's hook input carries `permission_mode` (values include default/acceptEdits/bypassPermissions/plan) — treat bypassPermissions AND acceptEdits as "auto mode". hooks/classify.sh forwards it to the daemon /classify body. VERIFY the payload actually carries permission_mode (capture a real payload); if it does NOT, fall back to an env signal ORCH_AUTO_LOOP=1 read by classify.sh. Report which path you used.
2. ENFORCE IN CLASSIFY COMPOSER: in the classify response path (routes/classify.js + lib/classify-assemble.js / lib/ready-flag-cache.js), when auto-mode AND ready tasks exist AND there is NO active loop bound to this session → have the daemon directly POST /loop/start (default config: tokenBudget 80000, maxIterations 100, minPoll 30, maxPoll 300, batch 4, maxConcurrency 6, session=sessionId) and emit a confirmation line ("[Orchestrator] Auto-started loop <id> (auto mode)") INSTEAD of the "No active loop detected" nudge. Idempotent: if a session loop already active, do nothing.
3. NON-AUTO / hookless desktop app: keep the existing soft nudge unchanged (can't enforce without a hook). Respect the existing per-conversation opt-out ("orch off") — do not autostart if the session has opted out.
4. TEST: cover (a) auto-mode + ready + no loop → /loop/start called once + confirmation text, not nudge; (b) auto-mode + already-active session loop → no double-start; (c) non-auto → unchanged nudge; (d) opted-out → no autostart. Run the repo suite; ~12 failures are pre-existing on clean base — verify yours pass.

Surgical; reuse the existing loop registry/start path and classify composition. Do not rewrite the heartbeat.
